items.label: Important Note Before Purchase – Basic Unlocked Phones for Daily Use
items.value: This is a standard-performance unlocked android phones, designed for smooth daily tasks like calling, texting, and light apps. While it doesn’t offer high-end specs, it’s a great unlocked phones for teens, seniors, or as a reliable unlocked android phones for backup use. Please note: This device is only compatible with T - Mobile SIM cards. Not for MVNO. Not for e-SIM. Not a 5G phone. A budget-friendly choice among unlocked phones, perfect for essential needs! Unsupported for Metro, Mint, Verizon, Sprint, Visible, Straight Talk, Boost, Xfinity, US Cellular, AT&T, Cricket, Consumer Cellular, or Assur ance Wireles!

items.label: 6.6” HD+ Display & Comfortable Design – Smooth Android Experience
items.value: This Android phone unlocked features a 6.6-inch HD+ waterdrop display, offering clear visuals for videos, browsing, and reading. Running on android 12, it includes night light and dark theme, making it ideal for seniors in dim light use. With a slim 77mm width, lightweight 190g body, and ergonomic curved edges, this android phone ensures a comfortable one-handed grip. The matte-textured back adds extra grip, combining practicality with a sleek design—perfect for daily tasks in an android phone unlocked at an affordable price!

items.label: Up to 3+3GB RAM & Octa-Core Processor – Reliable Daily Driver
items.value: This unlocked cell phone features 3GB RAM + 3GB virtual RAM expansion (via settings: Settings > About Phone > RAM), ensuring smooth multitasking for everyday apps. Powered by an octa-core processor, this cell phone handles calls, messaging, and light gaming easily. While it comes with 16GB internal storage, you can easily expand it up to 256GB with a TF card (not inchlded) —great for photos, music, and apps. A budget-friendly unlocked cell phone that balances daily performance and storage flexibility!

items.label: 13MP Camera & All-Day Power – Reliable for Everyday Moments
items.value: This smart phone features a 13MP rear camera—perfect for capturing daily memories, though it won’t compete with high-end smartphones in low light or detail. The 4000 capacity keeps you snapping photos, browsing, and staying connected without frequent charging. Whether you’re documenting life or using it as a backup, this unlocked smart phone delivers dependable performance for casual users who need simplicity and endurance. A practical choice among budget-friendly smartphones!

items.label: Important Usage Tips – Keep Your Phone Safe & Functional
items.value: Before first use, charge this phone for at least 30 minutes. Avoid exposing your phone to high temperatures, and refrain from using it while charging to prevent overheating—if it feels unusually warm, power it down immediately. This unlocked phone is designed for reliability, but proper care ensures long-lasting performance. A simple, worry-free phone for everyday needs!
